meta_description: JT Decorators is your Nottingham painter and decorator. Interior and exterior work, free quotes, professional finish. Call 07876 753724 today.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior decorating that transforms your home. From feature walls to full room makeovers, we deliver a professional finish on time, every time.
services_subhead: Whether you need a quick refresh or a complete room transformation, we handle every decorating project with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Fresh walls, woodwork, and ceilings that brighten your living spaces. We prepare, prime, and paint to a professional standard using quality materials.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's exterior with expert masonry and rendering work. Weatherproof coatings that last, from fascias to full house repaints.

services.title: Feature Walls & Wallpapering
services.desc: Create impact with bold colours, textures, or bespoke wallpaper. Precise hanging and finishing that makes a real statement in any room.

services.title: Prep & Surface Treatment
services.desc: The foundation of flawless decoration. We strip, sand, fill, and prepare every surface properly — no shortcuts, no peeling paint after six months.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Shops, offices, and rental properties finished to professional standards. Scheduled work with minimal disruption, and competitive rates for larger projects.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Textured coatings, faux effects, and bespoke colour matching. We work with premium paints and techniques to achieve the exact look you want.

about_pullquote: I treat every home like it's my own — no shortcuts, just honest work and a fair price.
about_para_1: JT Decorators was founded on a simple idea: deliver expert, reliable painting and decorating without the inflated bills. Over 15 years, we've built our reputation on thorough preparation, quality materials, and a finish that lasts. We're based in Stapleford and know Nottingham inside out.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen, we're punctual, and we genuinely care about the result. No rushed jobs or cut corners — whether it's a single room or a full exterior respray, we approach every project with the same attention to detail. We're proud to be the decorator families in Nottingham trust.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the entire downstairs painted during lockdown. JT was professional, tidy, and the work was immaculate. He spotted damp issues we didn't know about and gave honest advice without trying to upsell us. Couldn't ask for better. Recommend him without hesitation.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Came to do our kitchen and dining room. Preparation was thorough — he filled cracks, sanded everything properly. The finish is crisp and clean, exactly what we wanted. Fair price and he was in and out on schedule. Booking him again for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Needed the outside of the house done before winter. JT quoted quickly, started on time, and weatherproofed everything properly. No mess left behind, and he's already back to do the interior. Reliable bloke, honest prices. Five stars.
reviews.author: David P.
